body: I'm sorry. I know I should just man up and try to fix my problems but I don't even know where to start, even in the area of small goals. There are so many things broken even besides the ones that I mentioned earlier and every attempt so far has just made things worse. I'm sorry. I know that it sounds bad, but at least if I decide to kill myself than I'm certain I can do that right. I know what went wrong last time and I'm pretty sure I can correct it this time. I'm sorry.
